body:
Related to #2862
In equity total return swaps, the equity leg has only one payment. Extended EquityTotalReturnSwap with an optional equity payment frequency, reusing EquityCashFlow for each settlement period.

review_comments.body: Instead of defining a new enumeration, you could pass the frequency of the equity payments.  `Once` or `0` would give you the current payment at maturity, while passing a different frequency would also allow you to create equity cash flows independently of the frequency of the funding leg.

I would probably add the new argument at the end of the existing constructors, instead of defining new ones.  They might multiply quickly if we keep adding flags for optional resets, dividends and whatnot.
